'''Mellaw Doowon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] and [[Ommni box/Legends|ommni box]] player in a [[Band/Legends|band]] called the [[Dewback Ramblers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|He travelled here to Tatooine using the wrong travel papers. I guess he never should have given his name as ""Lord Vader."" Anyway, the authorities are after him, so I need you to bring him here safely. Okay?|Blerx Tango, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Mellaw Doowon and the Dewback Ramblers operated out of the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|Lucky Star]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:BT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Mellaw Doowon made some bad jokes to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities outside of Mos Entha. The [[Band/Legends|band]] leader [[Blerx Tango]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Mellaw, and bring him back safely. The spacer agreed, but was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] that would not let Mellaw be escorted.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mellaw Doowon was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:BT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, players doing a mission for Blerx Tango had to rescue Mellaw.<ref name="SWG:BT" />
